name: Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund - Euro Share Class
oneLiner: EURSPKCC is the EUR share of Spiko's Digital Assets Cash & Carry fund, a French FPS combining crypto basis-trade exposure with short-duration T-bills.
collateral: Euro share class of the Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund, combining systematic cash-and-carry exposure with short-duration cash and Treasury-bill collateral.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share class; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko fund-transfer rails.

jurisdiction.license: French Fonds Professionnel Specialise (FPS) / Alternative Investment Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EURSPKCC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: EURSPKCC Ethereum mint/burn is restricted by Spiko's verified Token.sol implementation and shared authority policy contract; Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Starknet, and Stellar routes remain unresolved.

controls.label: EURSPKCC token restricted mint/burn
controls.evidence: Ethereum lane reads returned implementation 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, owner() = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, and authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. Source review showed mint and burn are restricted() calls.

controls.label: Spiko authority policy contract
controls.evidence: Token authority() returned this shared policy contract; current policy rules, signer custody, and admin setup were not decoded in this lane.

review.evidence: Verified Ethereum implementation source and direct reads show EURSPKCC mint/burn routed through Spiko's restricted authority contract rather than an owner EOA.
unresolvedQuestions: Decode the shared Spiko authority policy contract signer/admin setup before adding Safe-like details.
Resolve Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Starknet, and Stellar mint or bridge authorities before claiming multichain completeness.
